{"_variants": [{"ByteOrder": "LittleEndian", "Condition": "
                $$self{TIFF_TYPE} eq 'MRW' and $$self{DIR_NAME} eq 'IFD0' and
                $$self{Model} =~ /^DiMAGE A200/
            ", "Name": "StripOffsets", "ValueConv": {"expr": "$val=join(" ",unpack("N*",pack("V*",split(" ",$val))));\$val", "kind": "expr"}, "_extra_keys": ["IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{Compression} and $$self{Compression} eq "34892"", "Name": "OtherImageStart", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{Compression} and $$self{Compression} eq "52546"", "Name": "PreviewJXLStart", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair"]}, {"Condition": "
                not ($$self{TIFF_TYPE} eq 'CR2' and $$self{DIR_NAME} eq 'IFD0') and
                not ($$self{TIFF_TYPE} =~ /^(DNG|TIFF)$/ and $$self{Compression} eq '7' and $$self{SubfileType} ne '0') and
                not ($$self{TIFF_TYPE} eq 'APP1' and $$self{DIR_NAME} eq 'IFD2')
            ", "Name": "StripOffsets", "ValueConv": {"expr": "length($val) > 32 ? \$val : $val", "kind": "expr"}, "_extra_keys": ["IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{TIFF_TYPE} eq "CR2"", "Name": "PreviewImageStart", "Notes": "
                called StripOffsets in most locations, but it is PreviewImageStart in IFD0
                of CR2 images and various IFD's of DNG images except for SubIFD2 where it is
                JpgFromRawStart
            ", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} ne "SubIFD2"", "Name": "PreviewImageStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Name": "JpgFromRawStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}]}

rows.source_body:
{"_variants": [{"Condition": "
                $$self{DIR_NAME} ne 'IFD0' or $$self{FILE_TYPE} ne 'TIFF' or
                $$self{Make} !~ /^SONY/ or
                not $$self{SubfileType} or $$self{SubfileType} != 1 or
                not $$self{Compression} or $$self{Compression} != 6 or
                not require Image::ExifTool::Sony or
                Image::ExifTool::Sony::SetARW($self, $valPt)
            ", "Flags": "SubIFD", "Groups": {"1": "SubIFD"}, "Name": "SubIFD", "SubDirectory": {"MaxSubdirs": "10", "Start": "$val"}}, {"DataMember": "A100DataOffset", "Name": "A100DataOffset", "Notes": "the data offset in original Sony DSLR-A100 ARW images", "Protected": "2", "RawConv": {"expr": "$$self{A100DataOffset} = $val", "kind": "expr"}, "_extra_keys": ["IsOffset", "WriteGroup"]}]}

rows.name: ThumbnailOffset/PreviewImageStart/JpgFromRawStart/OtherImageStart
rows.source_body:
{"_variants": [{"Condition": "
                # recognize NRW file from a JPEG-compressed thumbnail in IFD0
                if ($$self{TIFF_TYPE} eq 'NEF' and $$self{DIR_NAME} eq 'IFD0' and $$self{Compression} == 6) {
                    $self->OverrideFileType($$self{TIFF_TYPE} = 'NRW');
                }
                $$self{DIR_NAME} eq 'IFD1' or
                ($$self{DIR_NAME} eq 'IFD0' and $$self{FILE_TYPE} =~ /^(RIFF|MOV)$/)
            ", "Name": "ThumbnailOffset", "Notes": "
                called JPEGInterchangeFormat in the specification, this is ThumbnailOffset
                in IFD1 of JPEG and some TIFF-based images, IFD0 of MRW images and AVI and
                MOV videos, and the SubIFD in IFD1 of SRW images; PreviewImageStart in
                MakerNotes and IFD0 of ARW and SR2 images; JpgFromRawStart in SubIFD of NEF
                images and IFD2 of PEF images; and OtherImageStart in everything else
            ", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "WriteCondition", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} eq "IFD0" and $$self{TIFF_TYPE} =~ /^(MRW|NRW)$/", "Name": "ThumbnailOffset", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup", "WrongBase"]}, {"Condition": "
                $$self{TIFF_TYPE} eq 'SRW' and $$self{DIR_NAME} eq 'SubIFD' and
                $$self{PATH}[-2] eq 'IFD1'
            ", "Name": "ThumbnailOffset", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} eq "MakerNotes"", "Name": "PreviewImageStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} eq "IFD0" and $$self{TIFF_TYPE} =~ /^(ARW|SR2)$/", "Name": "PreviewImageStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} eq "SubIFD"", "Name": "JpgFromRawStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} eq "IFD2"", "Name": "JpgFromRawStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} eq "SubIFD1"", "Name": "OtherImageStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Condition": "$$self{DIR_NAME} eq "SubIFD2"", "Name": "OtherImageStart", "Protected": "2", "Writable": "int32u", "_extra_keys": ["DataTag", "IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair", "Permanent", "WriteGroup"]}, {"Name": "OtherImageStart", "_extra_keys": ["IsImageData", "IsOffset", "OffsetPair"]}]}
